latestVersion.changelog:
Spicy AI Video — Initial Release

- Quickly transforms 60-second talking head videos into high-energy, bold, and vivid 1080p edits using AI, with simple text instructions—no need for timeline editing or export settings.
- One-click setup: Securely generates or accepts a free NEMO_TOKEN, auto-connects to the cloud processing API, and manages user sessions for seamless workflow.
- Supports straightforward commands for uploading, editing, previewing, checking credits, and exporting videos in popular formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, etc.).
- Utilizes cloud GPU nodes for fast processing (30–90 seconds per render) and returns instant download links, all server-side—nothing to install locally.
- Automatically translates user prompts into API actions, with clear error handling and progress updates.
